_encoding_note: This file is written in RAW characters, not \uXXXX escapes, on purpose. Escaped copy is scanned correctly but is invisible to a reviewer's grep, and an unreviewable channel is how a forbidden string survives review.
_w3_decision: PRD L290 (W-3) requires the client band view to carry BOTH notices on the same screen: (1) band.w3_notice_scope -- 手环数据为参考之一，不用于单方判定, and (2) band.w3_notice_sync_time -- 数据同步时间. The PRD records that a missing sync time is an acceptance failure. Neither ruled sentence contains a wordlist term, so the ruled wording and the ADR-12 gate are not in tension; the ruled wording is what the gate expects to see.
